fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi PIF concentrated 80.2% of its U.S. equity portfolio in SPCX ($23 billion scale), though per-share value declined from $170.86 to $150.86.
fields.summary_ko.1: Following EA's $55 billion privatization, PIF's SPCX allocation rose from 69.5% to 80.2%; SPCX currently stands at $141.70, up 3.16%.
